summary: Kaggle competition on compiling quantum circuits with verifiable results. No quantum physics background required per the organizers.
eligibility: Kaggle account holders aged 18+, worldwide except Crimea, DNR, LNR, Cuba, Iran, North Korea and US-sanctioned persons. Teams of up to 5.
title: Google Quantum AI: Verifiable Quantum Circuit Compilation

prize.description: US$150,000: 1st US$50,000, 2nd US$25,000, 3rd US$10,000, 4th–6th US$5,000 each, plus milestone, longest-leader and single-task prizes.

notes: Join and merge teams by 13 Jan 2027.
